effects.name: Vignette
effects.description: Darkens the picture towards the corners.
whenToUse: draw the eye to the centre of the frame

params.name: amount
params.label: Amount
params.description: How dark the corners get (1 = black)

params.name: radius
params.label: Radius
params.description: Distance from the centre (0 centre, 1 corner) where darkening starts

effects.name: Gaussian Blur
effects.description: Separable gaussian blur (two passes). Radius is in pixels of the clip.
whenToUse: soften a busy background behind text
animate radius for a focus pull

effects.name: Chromatic Aberration
effects.description: Separates the red and blue channels like a cheap lens.
whenToUse: add a lens or glitch feel
punch up a beat or impact

params.name: amount
params.label: Amount
params.description: Channel offset as a fraction of the frame

params.name: angle
params.label: Angle
params.description: Direction of the split in degrees (ignored when radial)

params.name: radial
params.label: Radial
params.description: Split grows from the centre to the edges

effects.name: Cross Fade
effects.description: The outgoing picture dissolves into the incoming one.

effects.name: Wipe
effects.description: A soft edge sweeps across the frame along a direction.
whenToUse: reveal along a direction of motion

params.name: direction
params.label: Direction
params.description: Where the edge travels (x right, y up); (1, 0) sweeps left to right
